data.narrative:
Arxlight is a seed-stage frontier-tech company operating in Defense & Security, competing within a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers. The private peer set includes UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic; public comparables are tracked via DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach given available data. Analysis across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage peers—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Castelion ($1.0B, Series A), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yielded a median valuation of $1.0B. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting material dispersion around stage progression and technology differentiation within the Defense & Security sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and the inherent heterogeneity of seed-stage defense companies at different maturity points. Key uncertainties include: the materiality of Arxlight's IP and technical differentiation relative to the sampled peer set, capital intensity and path to revenue, and regulatory or procurement dependencies specific to the defense sector. Additional revenue, margin, or funding trajectory data would strengthen conviction in this range.
